alternatives_considered.approach: Bayesian conjugate posterior for the evaluator instead of a normal-approx z-test
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: L2 Bayesian machinery is heavier than the ticket needs; the z-test with a min-sample gate deterministically produces the required first-class inconclusive, and L3/L4 methods are explicitly out of scope

alternatives_considered.approach: Storing only the final score instead of all eight components
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: TR-18 requires stored score components so the ranker's own calibration can be evaluated later; a bare score is undebuggable

validated_work_order.approach: Add two pure domain modules (no IO, {code,message,details} errors): src/domain/opportunities.js implements the spec section 26 formula Score = value x pSuccess x fit x infoValue x reversibility / cost / downside / delay with divisor floors (cost_micros, downside_micros, delay_days each floored at 1 so a zero cost can never divide by zero or score infinite), integer-micros expectedContribution = trunc(value_micros x pSuccess) - cost_micros, and deterministic ranking (score desc, id asc tiebreak); src/domain/experiments.js implements L1 native A/B evaluation as a min-sample gate plus a two-proportion z-test at |z| >= 1.96, returning win/loss/inconclusive where any gate failure yields inconclusive and never a forced binary. Persist both behind tenant-bound tables (migration 005) and repositories, expose POST/GET /v1/opportunities plus POST/GET /v1/experiments and POST /v1/experiments/:id/evaluate with the standard error envelope and idempotent re-posts, render the ranked list with all eight components and experiment cards with caps/stop/state/data-through from the repositories (replacing the dead opportunity.scored/experiment.started raw-event reads nothing ever writes), keep the composer draft in localStorage so fetch failures preserve it, and seed three ranked opportunities plus one running experiment. Meta-first per the recorded answer: no Google experiment adapter; native A/B plus Bayesian levels only.

files.change: Pure module: validateOpportunity (opp_ id prefix, tenant_id, all eight components with types; cost/downside as integer micros, delay as days number, probabilities/fit/reversibility/info in [0,1+] ranges), scoreOpportunity (spec section 26 formula with divisor floors of 1), rankOpportunities (score desc, id asc), expectedContribution (integer micros: trunc(value_micros * pSuccess) - cost_micros). Computed example pinned: value=1000 p=0.5 fit=0.8 info=1.2 rev=0.9 cost=100 downside=2 delay=1 yields 2.16. Invariant: shares rank by expected contribution descending; scores are finite positive numbers. Errors as {code,message,details} with codes OPP_BAD_ID, OPP_BAD_COMPONENT, OPP_BAD_MONEY. Never imports node:sqlite.

Pure module: validateExperiment (exp_ id prefix, tenant_id, arms [{id, name}], caps {max_spend_micros integer > 0, max_downside_micros integer > 0}, stopRules {min_runtime_hours, min_sample integer > 0, success_threshold, harm_threshold}, state draft|running|matured|stopped, data_through UTC ISO-8601), evaluateExperiment ({control_conversions, control_exposures, treatment_conversions, treatment_exposures, min_sample, threshold z=1.96}: total conversions < min_sample yields {state: inconclusive, reason: underpowered}; else two-proportion z-test, |z| < 1.96 yields inconclusive, sign yields win/loss; never forced), stopRuleTriggered (harm threshold or cap breach). Computed example: 10/1000 vs 12/1000 with min_sample 100 yields inconclusive (22 total < 100). Codes EXP_BAD_ID, EXP_BAD_ARMS, EXP_BAD_CAPS, EXP_BAD_STOP_RULES. No IO imports.

validated_work_order.understanding: Issue #22 is the strategist slice of epic #14: rank competing bets with stored score components (spec section 26 opportunity economy: value x pSuccess x fit x infoValue x reversibility / cost / downside / delay) and settle them with L1/L2 experiments (native A/B plus Bayesian levels) that carry caps, stop rules and a first-class inconclusive state, reusing the quality funnel (qualified CPL over downstream events) so a cheap low-quality campaign loses to an expensive high-quality one on expected contribution. The codebase today has no scoring or evaluation code: src/web/pages.js renders opportunities/experiments from placeholder raw events (opportunity.scored, experiment.started) that nothing ever writes, and there is no src/domain/opportunities.js, src/domain/experiments.js, no tables, and no API for either. Dependencies #19 (decision journal) and #21 (research mesh plus learnings) are merged, so the decision record, research-observations panel and retrieval gate exist to consume. The recorded human answer (Meta Ads first, Google after) means no Google experiment adapter in this slice.
